text: {"features":[{"name":"Software engineering track record","description":"How strongly the letter establishes relevant professional experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows only a near-threshold professional history, with limited production scope and little sense of repeated launches."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows clear qualifying experience but still a relatively modest record of production delivery."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents solid mid-level experience across testing, maintenance, and launch of several production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates strong experience through many years of full-lifecycle work and repeated production launches."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter conveys an extensive, highly mature track record with sustained multi-year work and a large portfolio of launched services."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows practical depth building production systems in Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Go is mentioned only to meet the requirement, with no evidence that it is a central implementation language."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter identifies Go as a regular language but offers little concrete indication of depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid production use of Go across meaningful service work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter ties Go to concrete back-end system design, operation, or security tooling responsibilities."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes Go a standout strength by showing central, production-grade use plus ownership of substantial Go back-end architecture."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates practical Python experience relevant to automation, tooling, or services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of Python experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Python briefly or vaguely, without showing how it is used."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly shows working Python experience in automation, tooling, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents Python as a major part of the candidate's work, especially for automation, analysis, or internal services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows deep, production-grade Python capability, often with quality signals or a central role in agent and automation systems."}]},{"name":"AI systems experience","description":"How strongly the letter shows hands-on experience building or deploying AI features relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention AI work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions AI only as interest or a generic buzzword, without shipped experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states hands-on experience building or shipping AI or language-model features."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows production AI work plus concrete attention to evaluation, trust, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates strong AI engineering depth by pairing shipped model-backed systems with careful control of reliability and deployment risk."}]},{"name":"Security assessment experience","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates ability to perform structured security assessments and follow findings through remediation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows no assessment experience beyond general security interest or credentials."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter hints at security review work but does not make actual assessment responsibilities clear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly states experience performing security assessments of systems or designs."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes structured assessment methods such as threat modeling, attack-surface review, code review, or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents security assessment as substantial hands-on practice with clear methods and follow-through from findings to remediation."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability response automation","description":"How strongly the letter shows experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of work on vulnerability intake, triage, or response workflows."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter expresses interest in automating security work but does not claim to have built such a workflow."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly says the candidate automated vulnerability handling or report triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explains concrete triage behaviors such as classification, routing, deduplication, prioritization, or queue reduction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents a delivered vulnerability-automation system with clear leverage, returning expert time or materially reducing manual response effort."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates design experience with agentic tools using controlled autonomy.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention agentic tooling or agents."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions agents in passing but gives no architectural detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly states experience building agentic systems that combine agents with supporting infrastructure."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explains how agents are decomposed, bounded, audited, or constrained in practice."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong design ownership of controlled agent architecture, especially Python agents governed by explicit Go-based guardrails."}]},{"name":"Algorithms depth","description":"How well the letter evidences practical fluency with data structures and algorithms in real engineering problems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not provide any signal of data-structures or algorithms skill."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter claims algorithmic strength but offers no concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives a clear example of using algorithms or data structures to improve a real system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter provides a strong practical example where a specific structure or algorithm materially simplified, stabilized, or sped up important work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter conveys standout algorithmic fluency through especially sophisticated examples or multiple concrete signals of turning hard problems tractable."}]},{"name":"Platform leverage mindset","description":"How strongly the letter shows motivation for foundational systems whose impact compounds across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not frame the work as foundational or organization-wide in impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions scale or impact in generic terms without showing a real preference for platform work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly values work whose benefits reach many teams rather than a single product."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter makes compounding, platform-level impact a major theme tied to past choices or future goals."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents a deeply internalized platform mindset centered on multiplier effects, inherited improvements, or fleet-wide protection."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"How strongly the letter frames security tooling as helping developers work securely with less friction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not discuss developers as users of the security systems being built."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter broadly wants to help teams but does not address usability or workflow friction."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly aims to reduce toil or make secure work easier for engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explicitly advocates for secure defaults, low-friction tooling, or proactive help to developer teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter consistently frames security as developer enablement, with a strong philosophy that the secure path should be the easy path."}]},{"name":"Security automation insight","description":"How thoughtfully the letter explains the security-engineering problem this role solves.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows interest in security work but offers no real analysis of the problem the team is solving."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mostly restates the posting or speaks about security impact in broad, unsurprising terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter identifies at least one concrete challenge such as manual triage, vulnerability response, or too much expert toil."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter frames security automation as a systems-design or capacity-multiplication problem rather than a set of isolated tasks."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter offers especially sharp, role-specific insight, such as scaling scarce expert judgment, multiplying one finding into wider protection, or embedding security through workflow defaults."}]},{"name":"Collaboration with security engineers","description":"How strongly the letter signals readiness to partner closely with information security specialists.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no signal about partnering with security practitioners or adjacent specialists."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter sounds generally team-oriented but does not connect collaboration to security work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter indicates willingness to work with security engineers or similar partners."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explicitly describes partnering with security specialists to build tooling, assessments, or response processes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes close collaboration with security experts a clear working style, often including learning from their practice while translating it into software."}]},{"name":"Technical ownership","description":"How strongly the letter conveys end-to-end responsibility for systems rather than only participation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter lists technologies or tasks without showing responsibility for a meaningful system or outcome."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter implies involvement in relevant work but leaves scope and ownership unclear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows ownership of implementing, maintaining, or improving meaningful components or workflows."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes end-to-end design, delivery, or operation of significant systems or tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter repeatedly demonstrates architect-level ownership, including designing boundaries, controls, or long-term stewardship of important systems."}]},{"name":"Reliability mindset","description":"How strongly the letter signals care for maintainability, correctness, and long-term operational quality.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no signal about maintainability, correctness, or long-term quality."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter implies professionalism but does not explicitly value reliable or inheritable systems."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly values stability, maintainability, or operational care in software work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter links past work or examples to reliability concerns such as defaults, failure modes, maintainership, or correctness."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes dependable, inheritable, high-standard systems a defining engineering philosophy tightly connected to security infrastructure."}]},{"name":"Self-directed engineering initiative","description":"How strongly the letter provides evidence of serious technical initiative beyond routine assigned work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no meaningful evidence of self-driven technical work outside ordinary job claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions only a small or lightweight side build with limited technical ambition."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows a sustained personal project, occasional upstream patching, or another clear example of self-directed work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents substantial self-driven work such as ambitious distributed-systems projects or regular open-source contributions."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows exceptional initiative through technically demanding long-running projects, maintenance of software used by others, or repeated upstream stewardship."}]},{"name":"Offensive security credibility","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates attacker-minded security practice through certifications or competitions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no external signal of attacker-minded security practice."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter offers only a basic signal such as Security+ or casual CTF participation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows meaningful offensive-security engagement through recurring CTF practice, a stronger certification, or similarly credible evidence."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates strong offensive credibility through OSCP, serious CTF results, or another demanding external signal."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter combines high-strength credentials with sustained high-level attacker practice, such as OSCP plus strong competitive results or an equivalent combination."}]},{"name":"Role-specific motivation","description":"How convincingly the letter explains why the candidate wants this exact role on this team.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The reason for applying reads as generic and could fit many software roles."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter gives a broad reason for interest in Google or security, but little about why this specific role fits."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives a clear role-specific motivation connected to the team's mission or responsibilities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter offers a convincing and personalized explanation of why this exact role is the next logical step."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter delivers a highly compelling, distinctive case for this role by tightly matching the candidate's goals to the team's specific mandate and challenges."}]},{"name":"Specificity of evidence","description":"How concretely the letter supports its claims with observable details rather than broad assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter relies mostly on broad assertions about skill or interest with little observable supporting detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter includes some specifics, but many important claims remain generic or weakly supported."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter supplies several concrete examples, technologies, or responsibilities that make the fit credible."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter consistently backs its claims with specific systems, methods, or before-and-after descriptions."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is richly concrete throughout, with crisp details that make scope, methods, and impact easy to trust."}]},{"name":"Organization and coherence","description":"How clearly and logically the letter is structured as a persuasive whole.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter feels disjointed or list-like, making the case hard to follow as a whole."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter is understandable but loosely structured, with abrupt transitions or an uneven progression."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter has a clear structure that moves logically through background, fit, and closing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is cohesive and well paced, with strong flow between motivation, evidence, and role fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is exceptionally coherent and purposeful, using structure to build a memorable and persuasive argument from start to finish."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"How polished the letter is at the sentence level in spelling, grammar, and proofreading.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter contains frequent spelling, grammar, or proofreading errors that noticeably distract from the application."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter contains multiple visible errors that weaken professionalism but do not block understanding."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter is generally readable with only occasional mistakes or awkward phrasing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is clean and professional with rare minor issues."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is polished and essentially error-free."}]}]}
